ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - HandleKatz Duplicating LSASS Handle
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects HandleKatz opening LSASS to duplicate its handle to later dump the memory without opening any new handles Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, GrantedAccess, CallTrace

sequences.query: (TargetImage = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") AND GrantedAccess = "0x1440" AND CallTrace = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\ntdll\\\.dll\\+") AND CallTrace = RGX(".*\\|UNKNOWN\\(.*") AND CallTrace = RGX("\\)$"))
